name: Grasping Currents

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

stealth.details: (trained) to notice a weird, faintly glowing ripple of the current beneath the water.

disable: DC 23 Religion check to calm the unquiet spirits in the waters for an hour, or light the Eternal Lantern (automatically disables the haunt)
reset: The grasping currents quickly build up power and can trigger again after 10 minutes have passed.
routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the grasping currents attempt to Grapple a swimming creature or capsize a rowboat by attempting an Athletics check with a +12 modifier. A creature that's Restrained by the grasping currents is pulled underwater and risks drowning. To capsize a rowboat, the haunt's Athletics check is rolled against the pilot's Athletics or Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

items.name: Ghostly Grasp
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to cross the lake by swimming or piloting a boat

---

Effect Ghostly arms reach up to grab and clutch at the creature or the boat, causing a –2 penalty to the Athletics or Piloting check that triggered the haunt. The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: A swath of drowned spirits tries to pull someone down into the water to join them.
